Freddy: He generally moves slower than Bonnie or Chica, but is much sneakier and can enter either hallway. You won't be able to see his eyes glaring at you through the doorway, so watch the cams or listen for his voice and close the door when he's near.
Bonnie: Approaches from the left. Watch the left hall camera or listen for his movements and close the left door when he’s near.
Chica: Approaches from the right. Watch the right hall camera or listen for her movements and close the right door when she’s near.

Foxy: Lurks in Pirate’s Cove, gradually emerging if he’s not being watched. Check on him often to make sure he doesn’t get too far and make a break for your office. In the situation that he does, close the left door to stop him.
Golden Freddy: He’ll sometimes appear in your office when flipping down the camera. Quickly throw on the mask or flip the monitor up again to make him go away.
Toy Freddy: He plays on the arcade cabinets in the dining area, and will sometimes come to your office asking for Frick-coins to continue playing. Pay up to avoid his attack.

Toy Bonnie: He climbs through the vent system, eventually making his way to your office. Listen for noises coming from the vents, and put on the mask when he’s near. He can also be held in place with the audio lure.
Toy Chica: She’ll send her cupcake into the office to spy on you before attacking. Click on the cupcake to remove it and avoid her attack.

Mangle: Also lurks in Pirate’s Cove, though unlike Foxy, Mangle will become more aggressive each time he's seen. Pay attention to the poster in your office to know who’s in the cove at any given time and avoid looking at him.

Balloon Boy: He climbs through the vent system, eventually making his way to your office. Listen for his voice, and put on the mask when he’s near. He is immune to the audio lure and will temporarily disable your flashlight if he gets in the office.

Withered Freddy: When you hear his music box start to play, it’s pizza time. Find four slices of pizza on the cameras and click on them before his song ends to calm him down for the rest of the night.
Withered Bonnie: When he appears in your office, throw on the mask and keep it on until he leaves to avoid his attack.

Withered Chica: She climbs through the vent system, eventually making her way to your office. Listen for noises coming from the vents, and put on the mask when she’s near. She can also be held in place with the audio lure.
Withered Foxy: He’ll appear in the window at the front of your office. Shine your flashlight on him for a few seconds to make him go away.
Marionette: Reset the music box over at the prize corner frequently to keep him happy.
Endoskeleton: Its eyes will sometimes be glowing and staring at you through the office window. Don’t shine your flashlight at it when it’s there, and it'll eventually go away.
RXQ: Slowly materializes in your office, appearing more quickly as the building heats up. Shine your flashlight on him to make him go away.

The Phantoms: They’ll appear on the camera view at random. Close or switch the cam quickly to avoid their attack. They can't kill you, but they will disable some of your tools and cause a loud audio disturbance if looked at for too long.
Springtrap: He climbs through the vent system, and can only be kept away with the audio lure. He isn't fooled by the mask.
Nightmare Fredbear: If the building gets too hot, his teeth will begin closing in on you, ready to eat your face. Cool the room back down quickly, or else you’ll be the next bite victim.

Nightmare BB: When he's in the building, balloons will begin to appear in your office. Click on these balloons to pop them before they reach the top of the screen, or else Nightmare BB will attack. The warmer your office is, the faster the balloons will rise.
Nightmarionne: He will randomly appear on the cameras, creating a loud audio disturbance and causing the building's temperature to rise. Shake the mouse to make him vanish.
Lolbit: Runs the prize corner, selling items that might be useful for your survival. The prices of these items increase with Lolbit’s difficulty.
Mr. Hippo: He too climbs through the vents, much like Toy Bonnie and Withered Chica. Luckily, he can't kill you...though he will cause a lengthy audio disturbance if he gets in the office.
Lefty: He gradually emerges from the supply closet if you’re too loud. Keep the noise down, or else he'll silence you himself.
Molten Freddy: Approaches through either hallway, though he’s invisible to the cameras. His beatboxing will give his position away, so listen for it and close the appropriate door.
Scrap Baby: She'll appear in the Parts and Service room, draining your power and making a lot of noise. Zap her with a controlled shock and she'll stop.

The Wolf: He’ll suddenly appear in your office when flipping down the monitor. Click on his flashing illusion disc to disable it, turning him back into a regular, nonthreatening marketable plushie and stopping his attack.

Glitchtrap: He'll slowly materialize with each flip of the monitor, eventually jumpscaring you if he's fully visible. Minimize your monitor flips and make the most out of each of them to prevent that from happening.
LolzHax: He’ll summon a new, randomly selected guest character from another universe when he appears. His difficulty determines how many characters he’ll summon.
Vector: When summoned, he'll wander around the pizzeria, making various hilarious quips and causing an audio disturbance in the process.
Snake: He'll place a bomb in a randomly selected room in the pizzeria. Find this bomb on the cameras and click on it to deactivate it before Snake detonates it.
Teddie: ???
Skull Kid:
Zipper: ???
Grillmeister: When summoned, your Freddy mask will be replaced with a new one. This mask works just as well, but don't leave it on for too long, or else some weird things might start to happen.

Nexus: He'll cause the temperature to rise as long as he's active, jumpscaring you if the it reaches 99 degrees. Keep the building cool until he eventually gets bored and leaves you alone to avoid his attack.
C0N-R0Y: He'll take a moment to fully activate upon being summoned. Once he is and he enters your office, throw on the mask quickly before he can identify you to avoid his attack.
Michi: She'll steal the music box, making it impossible to reset the Puppet's music until you buy it back from her at the prize corner.

Rodney: He'll gradually make his way to your office, causing the lights to flicker upon entering. Once he does, refrain from putting the mask on, or else the sight of Freddy Fazbear will send Rodney into a rage, ending your run.

Papa Fredbear: Upon being summoned, he'll invite himself into your office and give you a stern talking to. While he can't kill you, his rambling will cause an audio disturbance, and there's nothing you can do to stop his attack.

I'm a busy bear, and frankly, I have better things to do than loiter around your sad excuse for a pizzeria!

Because of that, some employees have to double up on their duties! It's key to keeping the company going.
That includes you! Not only do you get to be a security guard, but you also have the honor of being the company's one and only animatronic salvager!
Doesn't that make you feel special?
Your job's actually pretty simple - investigate this pizzeria, find animatronics, try talking to them, and take them home if you think I - er, we, could get some use out of them!

input0: to
Hey there, buddy! Let me tell you a little something!
Every building you'll visit'll have 7 different animatronics in it!
Five of which are ones you can salvage, though one of those five might be a little harder to find!
The other two are yours truly and the Puppet! If you find where he is, he'll point you towards where a super special secret animatronic might be hiding!
You can't salvage us, but we'll give you plenty of helpful tips if you ask!
Oh yeah, and I can tell you a bit more if you talk to me again!
This location was closed around 1993.
I don't really know why, but the animatronics have stayed in surprisingly good condition considering they've been here for over 20 years!
You'd be surprised by the amount of stuff Frickbear Entertainment's parent company owns!
Theme parks, fast food chains, alien research labs, old folks homes, you name it! All of them even have animatronics!
...And all of them have closed down recently.
It seems like the location you work at is more of a storage unit than a restaurant, so you could probably find some of those animatronics in the back room if you look hard enough.
Though keep in mind, they don't quite follow the same...regulations that we Frickbear Entertainment animatronics follow, so they might be a bit more...
...strange...than usual.
Hey there, buddy! Let me tell you a little something!
If you want a good paycheck at the end of your week, you should try and salvage as many animatronics as possible!
You can get by salvaging just the animatronics you find laying around - but if you want a SUPER bonus, you'll have to search every nook and cranny of these places to find the special ones!
And get this: If you find all four of those special animatronics, you'll be in for a real surprise at the end of the week!
Though I guess there's no point in telling you now, huh? You already missed one of them!
Hey, uh...don't tell anyone, but rumor has it that a security guard had his frontal lobe bitten off by an animatronic at this location.
You didn't hear that from me, though!
And I won't tell you who did it either!
...Though I recommend you stay away from Kids' Cove for the time being.
I really wanna know what was going through the mind of whoever designed Toy Chica. She's making me feel things an animatronics really shouldn't feel...
...O-OH! Whoops! Didn't see you there! Heheh...
Uh, this place sure has some nice music, huh?
Hey there, buddy! Let me tell you a little something!
Some animatronics are more scared of you than you are of them! They'll completely freeze up if you watch them on the cameras!
Only some animatronics, though! Someone like Foxy might be afraid of the spotlight, but someone like Bonnie might not mind at all!
...And some like Mangle just get even less afraid of coming to get you if you look at them too much.
Try it out on the closet or parts and service cameras!
This location isn't even an official Freddy's location! This place originally opened as a horror attraction based on all the spooky stories surrounding Freddy Frickbear's pizza.
That's why it's called Frickbear's Fright!
This place is kind of low budget though, so that's why you won't be able to find many actual animatronics here.
You've heard rumors about that purple guy, right? The one named William Afton?
Well, that's what he allegedly went by, anyway. No one knows if that was even his real name.
Anyway, if you haven't, they say an employee at Freddy Frickbear's Pizza way back in the day was engaged in some serious criminal activity!
Like, uh...y'know...
...Child existence removals.
He's still at large too! Though, uh...the company probably doesn't want me mentioning that.
